sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.5-27B-heretic-GGUF is a quantized version of the Qwen3.5-27B-heretic language model, provided by mradermacher as static GGUF format files for efficient local inference. The base model originates from coder3101's Qwen3.5-27B-heretic, a 27-billion parameter text-to-text model designed for general-purpose language tasks.
